title: Risk of Impaired Performance Due to Reduced Muscle Mass, Strength, and Endurance
description: Evidence book evaluating human skeletal muscle atrophy in microgravity, efficacy of the T2 treadmill, CEVIS cycle ergometer, and ARED resistive exercise systems.
citation: NASA Human Research Program Evidence Book, NASA/TP-2019-220042

title: Risk of Early Onset Osteoporosis Due to Spaceflight
description: Comprehensive evidence report documenting bone mineral loss rates, biochemical markers of bone turnover, and pharmaceutical countermeasures (bisphosphonates).
citation: NASA Human Health Countermeasures Element, NASA/TM-2020-220455

title: Risk of Adverse Cognitive or Behavioral Conditions and Psychiatric Disorders in Exploration Missions
description: Analysis of isolation, circadian desynchronization, workload distribution, and crew cohesion impacts during long-duration exploration.
citation: NASA Behavioral Health and Performance Evidence Report, NASA/TM-20210015822

title: Space Radiation Cancer Risk Projections and Uncertainties for Exploration Missions
description: Biophysical modeling of heavy ion radiobiology, track structure physics, and tissue weighting factors for lunar and Mars surface scenarios.
